description: Log into a Hilan tenant and download Form 106 (annual tax summary) for a given year, or the default year

tenant.description: Tenant subdomain, e.g. "amdocs". Optional if this server has COMPANY_URL / COMPANY_TENANT / COMPANY_CODE set in its env

year.description: Tax year, e.g. "2025" (defaults to the tenant's current default year)

name: syncForm106
